title: Corbell's private source on the existence of the S-4 facility

tellings.quote: And what that is is why I knew that Bob Lazar was telling it as it is, meaning a facility like that exists.

plain: S-4, a secret site in Nevada where a man named Bob Lazar says he once worked on alien craft, really exists, according to a private source of the filmmaker Jeremy Corbell. Corbell tells Michels that what this source told him is "why I knew that Bob Lazar was telling it as it is, meaning a facility like that exists," though he does not name the source or say what exactly they told him.
